name: io.github.vkpdeveloper/calsdk
title: calsdk calendars
description: Google Calendar, Outlook, iCloud and CalDAV for agents: list events, find free time, book.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth access token with a Calendar scope

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Google refresh token, used with the client id and secret to stay signed in

environmentVariables.name: MICROSOFT_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Microsoft Graph access token with Calendars.ReadWrite

environmentVariables.name: MICROSOFT_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Microsoft refresh token, used with the client id to stay signed in

environmentVariables.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Microsoft client secret, for confidential apps

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_APPLE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Apple ID email for iCloud Calendar
